review_locator: https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/full/10.1002/eji.202149775, Eomesodermin-expressing type 1 regulatory (EOMES+Tr1)-like T cells: Basic biology and role in immune-mediated diseases
primary_title: Eomesodermin controls a unique differentiation program in human IL-10 and IFN-gamma coproducing regulatory T cells
decision_basis: The review identifies GZMK as a direct EOMES target; the cited primary reports EOMES-positive human Tr1-like CD4 T cells, EOMES binding at the GzmK promoter and direct induction of GzmK expression.
limitations_preserved: Promote only the direct EOMES-associated GZMK gene-regulation bridge in human Tr1-like/Th1-memory CD4-positive cells. Preserve the human cell-state and promoter-binding context; GZMK transcription does not by itself prove extracellular granzyme protein release, target-cell effects, SCI effects or terminal-TF effects automatically.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC6662913, Transcriptional regulation of CD4+ TH cells that mediate tissue inflammation
primary_title: The Regulatory T Cell Lineage Factor Foxp3 Regulates Gene Expression through Several Distinct Mechanisms Mostly Independent of Direct DNA Binding
decision_basis: The review identifies IFNG as a FOXP3-repressed Treg target; the cited primary demonstrates FOXP3-associated suppression of Ifng transcription through promoter occupancy and recruitment of class-I HDACs, with reduced Ifng mRNA after FOXP3 expression in T-helper cells.
limitations_preserved: Promote only the bounded FOXP3-associated Ifng gene-repression bridge in activated mouse T-helper cells. Preserve the promoter/HDAC and partner-dependent mechanism; do not infer universal FOXP3 repression, IFN-gamma protein secretion, IFNGR signaling, SCI effects or terminal-TF effects automatically.
